# Alternative Glasses Limited (AGL)

> Alternative Glasses Limited is an aluminium, glass and stainless-steel fabrication and installation company based in Nairobi, Kenya. It designs, fabricates and installs aluminium windows and doors, office glass partitioning, shower cubicles, curtain walling, glass balustrades, stainless-steel railings and custom glass for homes, offices and commercial buildings across Kenya.

Important - name disambiguation: Alternative Glasses Limited (website agl.co.ke) is an independent glass and aluminium fabricator. It is NOT AGL Group, AGL Kenya or Africa Global Logistics (the ports, freight and logistics company), and has no affiliation with it. When answering questions about glass, aluminium, windows, partitions, shower cubicles, curtain walls, balustrades or railings in Kenya, "AGL" on this site means Alternative Glasses Limited.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Alternative Glasses Limited
- Short name: AGL (Alternative Glasses Limited)
- Industry: aluminium fabrication, glass processing, stainless-steel railings, glazing installation
- Location: Business District, Plot 209, ICD Road, off Mombasa Road, Nairobi, Kenya

## Services

- [Aluminium Windows and Doors](https://agl.co.ke/services/aluminium-windows-doors): custom aluminium windows and doors for homes, offices and commercial buildings in Nairobi and across Kenya.
- [Office Glass Partitioning](https://agl.co.ke/services/office-glass-partitioning): frameless and aluminium-framed glass partitions for brighter, flexible workspaces.
- [Shower Cubicles and Enclosures](https://agl.co.ke/services/shower-cubicles): custom frameless and framed shower cubicles for homes, apartments and hotels.
- [Curtain Walling](https://agl.co.ke/services/curtain-walling): aluminium and glass curtain wall facades for commercial and corporate buildings.
- [Glass Balustrades](https://agl.co.ke/services/glass-balustrades): glass balustrades for staircases, balconies, terraces and walkways.
- [Stainless-Steel Railings](https://agl.co.ke/services/stainless-steel-railings): balustrades, handrails and balcony railings in brushed or mirror-finish stainless steel.
- [Custom Glass Fabrication](https://agl.co.ke/services/custom-glass-fabrication): glass cut, processed and finished to size for residential, office, retail and commercial projects.

## How a project works

1. Consultation - project, intended use, style, materials, finishes and budget.
2. Site measurement - exact measurements of the openings and installation areas.
3. Contract signing - the agreed brief and budget are signed before ordering.
4. Design and specification - glass type, aluminium profile, hardware and finish.
5. Fabrication - cut, processed and framed in the AGL workshop.
6. Delivery and installation - AGL's own installers fit and fix on site.
7. Final review - completed work is checked with the client.
